title: Volume 5, front 25a — the CBFS lens as code: the first independent census of the image we built

_meta.method: FMAP + CBFS parsed spec-fresh from the 25.12 tree headers imported at runtime; constants never from memory; packed layouts validated by exact consumption
_meta.instrument_lane: sandbox probe (scripts/vol5_cbfs_lens.py) — the repo's frozen surface untouched; this lens is the Volume 5 companion to fw.spi.map, which natively reports zero FVs on the CBFS world
honesty: read-only: no byte of the ROM changed; +0 octet holds
LZMA decompression uses the Python stdlib on the LZMA-alone format; any entry that fails to decompress is registered, never faked
the walk resyncs past voids in 64-byte steps; inter-entry voids are accounted, not skipped
attribute chain parse bounded by CBFS_METADATA_MAX_SIZE per header semantics

cbfs_master_header.wrapped_by_entry: cbfs_master_header (type CBFS_TYPE_CBFSHEADER — the struct is entry DATA on this image)
